attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across the 3-node RHEL 9 cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only async standbys built via pg_basebackup -R. Verified writes on node1 propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot identity via /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id and confirming replication/read-only status recovered after each restart, including a fresh write-then-replicate check after the primary's restart.
